candidates.historical_registry_note: CANDIDATE_SMALL under ADR-0007; source records a forward-shadow start on 2026-11-18. This is not a verified result of that shadow cohort.
candidates.formula: Daily 12-1 momentum: close(t-21)/close(t-252)-1; divide by 250-session standard deviation of daily returns (minimum 200 observations); choose the top 20 eligible names and weight equally.

candidates.historical_registry_note: CANDIDATE_SMALL under ADR-0007; source records a forward-shadow start on 2026-11-18. This is not a verified result of that shadow cohort.
candidates.formula: Within the top-500 eligible universe, rank industries by mean 126-session return, requiring at least eight eligible names; select the best three industries, then choose the top 20 names by daily 12-1 momentum and weight equally.

candidates.historical_registry_note: The registered historical result failed its two-period t-statistic gate; it is retained as a historical candidate, not a confirmed edge.
candidates.formula: At month end, compute 12-1 momentum and information discreteness = sign(12-1 return) x (share of down days - share of up days) over the 12-1 window; restrict to the lower half by information discreteness, choose the top 20 by momentum and weight equally.
